# Tenpai — project setup plan

<!-- AI-GENERATED by Claude (Claude Code), 2026-09-17 -->
<!-- Why: Project tooling and setup so study time goes to Flutter code. -->

## Context

Tenpai is a Flutter app teaching Riichi Mahjong to beginners, Duolingo-style. It is a school project whose real deliverable is the author learning Flutter. Claude acts as tutor and reviewer, never as feature implementer. This plan covers the setup that encodes that working mode into the repo (CLAUDE.md, hooks, agents, lints), the folder scaffolding, the design-token import workstream, and the build order up to a first milestone that proves the architecture.

Current repo state: fresh `flutter create` template (counter app), go_router + Riverpod already wired in `lib/app.dart`, `lib/shared/router/app_router.dart`, `lib/views/home_page.dart`. **Not a git repository yet.** No `.claude/` dir, no `design/`, no `docs/`.

## Verified facts (read from pub cache / SDK, not memory)

| Package | Installed | Notes that differ from tutorials |
|---|---|---|
| Flutter / Dart | 3.47.4 / 3.13.3 | Dart 3.13 has dot-shorthands (`mainAxisAlignment: .center`, already in template) and native primary constructors. |
| flutter_riverpod | 3.4.3 | `StateProvider`/`StateNotifierProvider` moved to `package:flutter_riverpod/legacy.dart` — do not use. Unified `Ref` (no `FutureProviderRef`). `Notifier<T>.build()`, `AsyncNotifier<T>.build()`. `Provider(isAutoDispose: true)` replaces `.autoDispose`. `Ref.mounted`. `AsyncValue.value` is null on error (`valueOrNull` removed). Failing providers **auto-retry** — tests with failing fakes must pass `retry: (_, _) => null`. Test helpers: `ProviderContainer.test(overrides: [...])`, `tester.container()`, `NotifierProvider.overrideWithBuild`. |
| go_router | 18.0.1 | Depends on **`material_ui`**, not `package:flutter/material.dart`. `isMaterialApp()` looks for `material_ui`'s `MaterialApp`; with the legacy import it silently falls back to a bare `HeroController`/non-Material transitions. `GoRouterRedirect = FutureOr<String?> Function(BuildContext, GoRouterState)`. Top-level `onEnter`. `StatefulShellRoute.indexedStack(branches:, builder:)`. Route `metadata`. `context.go/push/pop` extensions. |
| material_ui / cupertino_ui | 1.3.0 / 1.1.0 (transitive today) | Flutter 3.47 decoupled Material from the framework. `package:flutter/material.dart` is frozen, "scheduled for formal deprecation". Types are distinct between the two imports; mixing is officially "not recommended". Migration: `dart fix --apply --code=migrate_design_widgets` (fix code confirmed present in the Dart 3.13 analysis server). |
| freezed / freezed_annotation | 4.0.1 / 3.1.0 | `@freezed abstract class X with _$X { const factory X(...) = _X; }` for data classes, `sealed class` for unions. `final` inside constructor params no longer allowed. |
| flutter_lints / lints | 6.0.0 / 6.1.0 | Baseline includes `library_private_types_in_public_api`, `prefer_final_fields`, `prefer_initializing_formals`, `use_super_parameters`, `file_names`, `camel_case_types`. |
| riverpod_lint (not installed) | 3.1.9 on pub | Now a **native analyzer plugin** (`plugins:` in analysis_options, no pubspec entry, no custom_lint). Requires Dart 3.13 ✔. Hand-written-provider rules: `missing_provider_scope`, `provider_parameters`, `avoid_public_notifier_properties`, `avoid_ref_inside_state_dispose`, `async_value_nullable_pattern`, `protected_notifier_properties`. |

Claude Code hooks: PreToolUse stdin carries `tool_name`, `tool_input.file_path`, and `agent_type` when called from a subagent; deny via `{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"…"}}`. Hooks run inside subagents. UserPromptSubmit stdin carries `prompt`.

## Decisions (from Q&A)

- Tutor rule enforced by **hook with escape hatch** (`/implement` prefix grants lib/ writes for one turn).
- AI calls (quiz explanation, tile identification) **deferred to a BaaS function**; repositories get interfaces + fakes now. Tile identification will be a vision-LLM call.
- Tile art via **flutter_svg**.
- Progress persisted **in memory** until BaaS. *Superseded 2026-09-18: Cloud Firestore with offline persistence for progress, Isar for local-only data; see `docs/ROADMAP.md` decisions log.*
- Assumption: yaku JSON hosted as a static file (GitHub Pages / raw). Base URL lives in `core/network/`, injected so it can change.

## New dependencies (each justified)

| Package | Why | When |
|---|---|---|
| `material_ui`, `cupertino_ui` (direct deps) | Forced by go_router 18 and Flutter 3.47 decoupling; avoids two Material type universes. | Setup |
| `flutter_svg ^2.3.0` | Tile SVGs; Flutter has no native SVG. Imports widgets only, so material_ui-safe. | Milestone 1 (Tile widget) |
| `image_picker ^1.2.3` | Single-shot camera photo via system UI. Needs `NSCameraUsageDescription` on iOS. | Milestone 3 (scanner) |
| `riverpod_lint 3.1.9` (analysis plugin, not pubspec) | Catches Riverpod 3 misuse at analysis time. | Setup |

Explicitly **not** added: mocktail (hand-written fakes in `test/fakes/`), google_fonts (bundle TTFs under `assets/fonts/`), any BaaS SDK, any AI SDK (dio talks to the BaaS function).

## Workstream 1 — Scaffolding + lints

Files Claude writes (setup, before the hook is armed):

1. **Git is handled by the user** (init, staging, commits, branches). Claude never runs git write commands in this project; CLAUDE.md states this. Claude only proposes what to commit and when.
2. `flutter pub add material_ui cupertino_ui`, then `dart fix --apply --code=migrate_design_widgets`; verify no `package:flutter/material.dart` import remains (`grep -r "flutter/material" lib test`).
3. Move template shell into the agreed layout, nothing more:
   - `lib/app.dart` → `lib/app/app.dart`, class `TenpaiApp` (MaterialApp.router from material_ui, `ProviderScope` stays in `main.dart`).
   - `lib/shared/router/app_router.dart` → `lib/app/router.dart`, keeping a top-level `final appRouter`. Wrapping it in a provider (needed once redirects depend on auth state) is a Milestone 4 change the user makes.
   - Delete `lib/views/home_page.dart` and the counter widget test; replace with a placeholder `HomeScreen` that only renders the app name (proves theme + router).
4. Create the folder tree from the spec with `.gitkeep` in empty leaves: `lib/{app/theme,core/{network,errors,extensions,utils},mahjong/{models,widgets},design_system/{buttons,cards,feedback,layout},features/{learning,yaku,scanner,progress,auth}/{domain/{entities,repositories},data/{dtos,sources,repositories},presentation/{providers,screens,widgets}}}`, `assets/{lessons,tiles,fonts}`, `test/` mirroring `lib/`, `test/fakes/`, `design/`, `docs/plans/`, `tool/`.
5. `analysis_options.yaml`:
   - `include: package:flutter_lints/flutter.yaml`
   - `plugins: { riverpod_lint: ^3.1.9 }`
   - `analyzer.exclude: **/*.g.dart, **/*.freezed.dart`; `language: strict-casts, strict-inference, strict-raw-types: true`
   - `errors:` promote to **error**: `unused_element`, `unused_field`, `unused_local_variable`, `public_member_api_docs`, `always_use_package_imports`, `require_trailing_commas`.
   - Rules (all confirmed present in Dart 3.13 analysis server):
     - Naming/privacy pressure: `public_member_api_docs` (every public symbol needs a dartdoc → makes "accidentally public" cost something and feeds the doc reviewer), `type_annotate_public_apis`, `use_late_for_private_fields_and_variables`, `sort_constructors_first`, `avoid_positional_boolean_parameters`, `use_setters_to_change_properties`, `avoid_field_initializers_in_const_classes`.
     - Imports/style: `always_use_package_imports`, `directives_ordering`, `require_trailing_commas`, `prefer_single_quotes`, `eol_at_end_of_file`, `flutter_style_todos`, `omit_obvious_local_variable_types`, `specify_nonobvious_local_variable_types`, `omit_obvious_property_types`, `specify_nonobvious_property_types`.
     - Correctness for beginners: `prefer_const_constructors`, `prefer_const_declarations`, `prefer_final_locals`, `prefer_final_in_for_each`, `avoid_dynamic_calls`, `unawaited_futures`, `avoid_catches_without_on_clauses`, `only_throw_errors`, `cast_nullable_to_non_nullable`, `no_default_cases` (pairs with sealed `LessonBlock`), `use_enums`, `unnecessary_lambdas`, `avoid_redundant_argument_values`, `prefer_asserts_with_message`, `use_colored_box`, `use_decorated_box`, `missing_code_block_language_in_doc_comment`, `unnecessary_async`, `unnecessary_ignore`.
   - What lints **cannot** enforce, and where it goes instead: the suffix table (Screen/Widget/Dto/Impl/Source), file-named-after-primary-class, "private unless another file needs it", provider naming. → `tool/check_conventions.dart` (a ~80-line script: for each `lib/**.dart`, primary class must match the file name in PascalCase; folder ⇒ required suffix; `*_providers.dart` must not declare `*NotifierProvider`; flag `public` top-level or member symbols referenced from no other file — best-effort via grep). Run by the code reviewer and in a `pre-commit` note in CLAUDE.md. Stays lightweight; the reviewer agent is the real enforcer.

## Workstream 2 — CLAUDE.md

Sections, in order (concrete rules, not prose):

1. **Working mode — hard rules**
   - Claude does not create or edit files under `lib/` unless the user's message starts with `/implement`. A hook enforces this; do not try to work around it via Bash.
   - "How do I …" → explain the concept, show ≤10-line illustrative snippet **inline in chat**, cite the relevant pub-cache source file. Never a whole file.
   - "Build X" → break it into steps with acceptance checks, point at the docs/API, user writes; Claude reviews the result.
   - "It's broken" → ask for the error text, locate the line, explain the cause; do not patch.
   - Reviews cite `file:line`; findings ranked; privacy violations are findings, not nitpicks.
   - Generated files (`*.g.dart`, `*.freezed.dart`) are produced by `dart run build_runner build -d`, never hand-edited.
2. **Check the source, not memory** — package APIs live at `~/.pub-cache/hosted/pub.dev/<pkg>-<version>/`. Riverpod 3 / go_router 18 / freezed 4 / material_ui differ from most tutorials; the verified-facts table above is copied in, condensed.
3. **Architecture** — the folder tree and the tie-break rules from the brief (Tile in `mahjong/`, no global usecases/models, DTO split only for foreign wire formats).
4. **Naming and privacy** — the suffix table, the privacy rules, provider naming, generated-file placement.
5. **Stack conventions** — Riverpod: `Notifier`/`AsyncNotifier`, no `legacy.dart`; providers in `*_providers.dart`; repositories injected via `xRepositoryProvider` and overridden in tests. go_router: routes in `app/router.dart`, `StatefulShellRoute.indexedStack` for tabs, path constants next to routes. freezed: `abstract class` + `const factory`, `sealed class` for `LessonBlock`.
6. **Commands** — `flutter analyze`, `flutter test`, `dart run build_runner build -d`, `dart run tool/check_conventions.dart`.
7. **Agents and write permissions** — the matrix from Workstream 4.
8. **Task carry-over** — plans live in `docs/plans/<date>-<topic>.md` + `.tasks.json`; status in `docs/ROADMAP.md` (per the global persisting-tasks rule).

## Workstream 3 — Enforcement hooks (project `.claude/settings.json`, committed)

- `.claude/hooks/guard_lib_writes.py` (PreToolUse, matcher `Edit|Write|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit|mcp__tokensave__tokensave_str_replace|mcp__tokensave__tokensave_multi_str_replace|mcp__tokensave__tokensave_replace_symbol|mcp__tokensave__tokensave_insert_at|mcp__tokensave__tokensave_insert_at_symbol|mcp__tokensave__tokensave_ast_grep_rewrite`):
  - Resolve target path from `tool_input` (`file_path` or `path`). If under `lib/` → deny unless grant file `.claude/.implement-grant` exists and is < 60 min old. Deny reason tells Claude to explain instead, and tells the user to prefix `/implement`.
  - Per-agent narrowing via `agent_type`: `test-writer` may write only `test/**`; `doc-reviewer` may write only `README.md`; `flutter-reviewer` has no write tools at all.
  - Also matcher `Bash`: deny commands that write into `lib/` by shell (`sed -i`, `>`/`>>` redirects, `tee`, `cp`/`mv` targeting `lib/`) unless grant present. `dart run build_runner` and `dart fix` are allowed (they touch generated files / migrations).
- `.claude/hooks/implement_grant.py` (UserPromptSubmit): if `prompt` starts with `/implement` → write grant file with timestamp; otherwise delete it. Grant is therefore single-turn and only the user can create it.
- `.claude/skills/implement/SKILL.md`: tiny skill so `/implement` is a real command; body: "User explicitly requested implementation this turn. Scope is exactly what follows the command. Still follow architecture/naming/privacy; still explain what you wrote and why."
- `.gitignore` adds `.claude/.implement-grant`.

Runs `flutter analyze` and `tool/check_conventions.dart` first. |
| Test writer | `test-writer.md` | Read, Write, Edit, Grep, Glob, Bash | sonnet | **Yes, to `test/**` only** (hook-enforced). Widget tests wrap in `ProviderScope(overrides:…, retry: (_, _) => null)` + material_ui `MaterialApp`; unit tests use `ProviderContainer.test()`. Fakes in `test/fakes/`, never mocks. Golden tests for `TileWidget` states. Never edits `lib/`; when a test reveals a bug it reports, not fixes. |
| Doc reviewer | `doc-reviewer.md` | Read, Grep, Glob, Edit, Write, Bash | sonnet | **Yes, `README.md` only** (hook-enforced). Reports on code docs: missing dartdoc on public API (cross-checks `public_member_api_docs` output), comments that restate code, missing intent comments on non-obvious logic (e.g. unlock rules). Maintains README against a fixed structure: Title/pitch, Screenshots, Features (school requirements checklist), Architecture (link to CLAUDE.md sections), Getting started, Content authoring (lesson JSON schema), Testing, Roadmap. |

Main-thread Claude: writes `CLAUDE.md`, `docs/**`, `.claude/**`, `analysis_options.yaml`, `tool/**`, `test/**` on request; never `lib/**` without `/implement`.

## Workstream 5 — Design import (`design/` → `app/theme/`)

1. **Inventory** — user drops exports into `design/`. Claude reads them and writes `design/README.md`: list of screens, components seen, tokens found (grep HTML/CSS for `--` custom props, `color:`, `font-family`, `border-radius`, `padding`).
2. **Tokens → theme (user writes, Claude reviews)** in this order:
   - `app_colors.dart` — `abstract final class AppColors` of `static const Color`: bone `#FAF7F0`, bamboo `#1E6B52`, vermillion `#D64541`, ink `#1C1A17`, muted `#8B8378`, plus whatever the export adds (surface variants, correct/incorrect greens/reds, tile face, tile back). No `MaterialColor` swatches.
   - `app_spacing.dart` — 4-pt scale (`xs 4 … xxl 32`), `radius = 16`, `tileRadius`, `tileAspect`.
   - `app_typography.dart` — font families from the export bundled as TTF in `assets/fonts/`, a `TextTheme` built from them.
   - `app_theme.dart` — `ThemeData` (material_ui) with an explicit `ColorScheme` (not `fromSeed`: the palette is authored), `scaffoldBackgroundColor: bone`, component themes for buttons/cards/chips using the tokens.
   - Rule enforced by the reviewer: no `Color(0x…)`, `EdgeInsets.all(<literal>)`, or `TextStyle(fontSize:…)` outside `app/theme/`.
3. **Component port order** (each = user builds, test writer adds golden/widget test, reviewer checks):
   1. `mahjong/models/tile.dart` (freezed) + `tile_suit.dart` + `tile_state.dart`, then `mahjong/widgets/tile_widget.dart` — the one renderer, `SvgPicture.asset` face, states normal/selected/correct/incorrect/highlighted/faceDown, red-five flag. Highest value: appears everywhere.
   2. `design_system/buttons/primary_button.dart`, `secondary_button.dart`.
   3. `design_system/feedback/answer_banner.dart` (correct/incorrect), `progress_bar.dart`.
   4. `design_system/cards/content_card.dart`, `design_system/layout/screen_scaffold.dart` (padding, safe area).
   5. `mahjong/widgets/hand_row.dart`.
   6. Feature widgets: lesson path node, quiz option, yaku card.
4. **Gallery route** — `/dev/gallery` (debug-only `GoRoute`) rendering every design_system component and all Tile states side by side. Cheap storybook; used for screenshot comparison against `design/`.

## Workstream 6 — Build order

**Milestone 1 — "architecture holds" (before any real content):** one vertical slice through every layer using placeholder content.
- `mahjong/`: `Tile` model (`1m…9m, 1p…9p, 1s…9s, 1z…7z`, `isRed`), `TileWidget`.
- `features/learning/domain`: `Lesson`, `Unit`, `LessonBlock` sealed (`explanation`, `quiz`; `drill`/`interactive` as empty variants), `LessonRepository` interface.
- `features/learning/data`: `LessonAssetSource` (rootBundle JSON), `LessonRepositoryImpl`, one authored `assets/lessons/unit_01_tiles.json` with 1 lesson of 3 blocks.
- `features/learning/presentation`: `lesson_providers.dart` (`lessonRepositoryProvider`, `unitsProvider`, `currentLessonProvider` as `AsyncNotifier`), `LessonPathScreen`, `LessonScreen` (block renderer switching on the sealed type), quiz feedback.
- `features/progress`: `ProgressRepository` interface + `InMemoryProgressRepository`; `userProgressProvider`; unlock rule as a use case only if logic is non-trivial.
- `app/router.dart`: `StatefulShellRoute.indexedStack` with Learn / Yaku / Scan / Profile branches (three are placeholders), `/lesson/:id`.
- Tests: `Tile` parse/format, `LessonBlock` JSON round-trip, `LessonScreen` widget test with overridden repository, `unitsProvider` unit test via `ProviderContainer.test`.
- Exit criteria: `flutter analyze` clean, `flutter test` green, complete a lesson on device, next lesson unlocks, hot restart resets (expected, in-memory).

**Milestone 2 — Yaku (REST):** `core/network/dio_provider.dart`, `YakuRemoteSource`, one freezed `Yaku` model (no DTO), `YakuRepositoryImpl`, Yaku Dex list + detail reusing `TileWidget`/`HandRow`, `AsyncValue` loading/error UI in `design_system/feedback/`.

**Milestone 3 — Scanner (camera):** `image_picker`, `TileIdentifier` interface + `FakeTileIdentifier` (returns a fixed tile), `ScanResultDto` (foreign wire format → DTO split justified), scan screen → tile card.

**Milestone 4 — BaaS decision:** compare Firebase vs Supabase against `AuthRepository`/`ProgressRepository` interfaces; implement both repos; swap the in-memory fake via provider override. *Superseded: Firebase (2026-09-17); `firebase_auth` + `firebase_app_check` + Firestore progress with offline persistence, Isar for local-only data (2026-09-18).*

**Milestone 5 — AI:** BaaS function proxies the LLM; `ExplanationRepository` (mistake → explanation), `TileIdentifierImpl` (photo → tile). Key never on device. *Superseded 2026-09-18: `firebase_ai` (Firebase AI Logic) behind App Check, no Cloud Functions.*

**Milestone 6 — Content + polish:** remaining units, `drill`/`interactive` blocks, animations, gallery parity with `design/`.

- `flutter analyze` passes with the new rule set on the scaffold (placeholder `HomeScreen` documented).
- `flutter test` green (placeholder smoke test).
- Hook check: ask Claude to edit `lib/app/app.dart` → denied with the explanation; `/implement touch lib/app/app.dart` → allowed; next plain turn → denied again.
- Agent check: run `test-writer` on `HomeScreen` → writes under `test/app/`; ask it to "fix" `lib/` → hook denies.

## Execution notes

- Order: material_ui migration → scaffold move → analysis_options → CLAUDE.md → hooks + skill → agents → tool script → docs/plans mirror → hand over to user for `git init` + first commit. Hook is armed last so setup edits to `lib/` are legal.
- CLAUDE.md "Working mode" gains a rule: no `git` commands that change state (init, add, commit, branch, push, stash, reset). Claude may run read-only git (`status`, `diff`, `log`) to inform reviews.
- On approval, mirror this plan into `docs/plans/2026-09-17-project-setup.md` + `.tasks.json` and create `docs/ROADMAP.md` (persisting-tasks skill).
- Nothing in `lib/` beyond the shell move and placeholder screen is written by Claude; theme, models, and features are the user's, reviewed.
